title: 2009 AMC 12A Problem 5
statement: One dimension of a cube is increased by \(1,\) another is decreased by \(1,\) and the third is left unchanged. The volume of the new rectangular solid is \(5\) less than that of the cube. What was the volume of the cube?

solutions.text:
Let the cube have side length \(x.\) The new solid has dimensions \(x + 1,\) \(x - 1,\) and \(x,\) so its volume is \(x(x+1)(x-1) = x^3 - x.\)

Setting this equal to \(x^3 - 5\) gives \(x^3 - x = x^3 - 5,\) so \(x = 5.\)

The cube’s volume is \(5^3 = 125.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
